name: Arkhipov Award
description: Choose de-escalation when tension is at least 80.

name: Historian
description: Make at least seven historical decisions.

name: Chaos Theorist
description: Survive eight decisions without following history.

name: Butterfly Collector
description: Open every consequence in a complete game.

name: Perspective
description: Play the same era as the US and USSR.

name: Long Game
description: Reach The Long Peace or The Grand Bargain.

name: Cassandra
description: Predict a historically followed advisor six times in one game.

name: Treasurer’s Friend
description: Finish with an economy of at least 80.

name: No Man’s Land
description: Finish with tension at 20 or below.
